evidence_span: Epilepsy: Epilepsy is more common in autistic individuals compared to the general population. In a recent review, higher rates of epilepsy in autism compared to their neurotypical peers were reported [odds ratio (OR): 3.26-24.2][44].

rationale: Đoạn về triệu chứng tiêu hóa và vi sinh đường ruột, không liên quan.

evidence_span: Hirosawa et al[45] reported higher rates of interictal epileptiform discharges (IED) in autistic children compared to their neurotypical peers.
